plan.title: Switch RFQ to Auction After Template Selection

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the initial event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Choose an RFQ template before adding the product.
Add the product whose retention after switching event type is being checked.
Switch the single-stage event from RFQ to Auction.
Verify that the current event type offers auction templates for selection.
Confirm the template must be selected again after the event-type switch.
Verify that the product row remains after switching from RFQ to Auction.
